protocol: day_sequential_rolling_anchor (S96): each day forecast BLIND before its session, flowing from the prior day's ACTUAL close + reveal fingerprint (grp7_reveals.json); blind wall intact per-day. overnight_gap_usd is guessed vs the prior FORECAST day's actual close (Mondays: vs Friday = the weekend gap).

days.archetype: stretched-swing pause / mild give-back at the G6->G7 seam, pre-storage-Thursday consolidation
days.reasoning: Flows from 1104 ACTUAL 4.317, the block HIGH after 4 strongly-up sessions (+2580/+530/+1110/+860) — the running path is at a cum-EXTREME, so direction.cross_block_reversion is armed. But the trigger is only HALF-lit: the 1104 reveal fingerprint shows NO continuation-collapse (big up-legs 10/13 continued = still-healthy old-swing; contrast 1008's 0/15), while the counter-move evidence is partial (day-hi +1650 faded to +860, last hour down -$30 — rhymes weakly with the 1007 last-hour roll-over, but the down-legs are the MORE exhausted side, turn_exhaustion -0.658). Per the brain: do NOT extend a trend into a stretched seam, do NOT blind-fade with the up-swing fingerprint still healthy. G6 lesson: reversion is a GIVE-BACK not a reversal, and the bearish storage surplus (+130 vs 5yr, last print Oct30 +74) is an UNRELIABLE lean vs rising HDD (7.8 gw_hdd shoulder). Wed = weak up-lean but overridden; non-catalyst day ahead of Thu 10:30 print caps magnitude, winter-transition vol keeps it from tiny. Play: morning continuation ATTEMPT up (block trend + Wed lean) that stalls below the 1104 high, then a US-afternoon give-back fade — small net down, two-sided chop, the real swing verdict deferred to storage Thursday.

days.archetype: storage-Thursday post-print breakout UP - one-day give-back exhausts, HDD up-swing resumes
days.reasoning: Flows from 1105 ACTUAL 4.264: the give-back day delivered (-520, my day-1 lean was right) but its own tape argues it is DONE, not extending - the day fell to -1100 then recovered more than half the drop and closed with a LAST-HOUR UP tick (+250), the give-back's own last-legs counter-move (the 0923-bounce analog applied to the give-back leg, per swing_exhaustion_reversion: treat each leg of the swing as its own exhaustible move). The 1105 fingerprint is MIXED - no one-sided continuation-collapse, both sides heavy peaked_fast (chop day) - so there is NO 1008-style old-swing collapse evidence against the underlying up-swing, whose 1104 fingerprint was still healthy (big up-legs 10/13). G6's load-bearing lesson fires: cross_block_reversion is a GIVE-BACK and the block can V back - do not marry the reversion past its own exhaustion, and the -530 cum from the 4.317 high plus the bounce off the day low reads as the give-back exhausting after one day. Backdrop: weather has moved shoulder->mod_heat (gw_hdd 11.2) - the same rising-HDD force that beat the bearish surplus through G6 week-2; the stale Oct30 print (+74 inject, +130 surplus) is fundamentally bearish but G6 proved HDD wins at the winter transition, and today's print covers a rising-HDD week. Plays fired: daytype.storage_thursday_magnitude (size UP hard - every scored storage Thursday produced a large dominant leg at/after 10:30 ET; 1030 broke out +2580 in exactly this HDD regime) + magnitude.catalyst_condition_sort (storage Thursday = up-sizer; G6 says do not clip the extreme) + swing_exhaustion_reversion applied to the give-back leg (its last hour turned) + fundamentals_role (HDD > surplus near winter). Side at the open is honestly a coin-flip per the brain, but the lean is UP with the running-path recovery: quiet slightly-firm overnight/pre-print drift following the last-hour up momentum, then the dominant leg at/after the 10:30 print - a grind-hold (ride the staircase, don't fade it), closing near the day's high and re-approaching the 1104 block high. Risk acknowledged: a fat-injection bearish surprise flips the post-print leg down (the 1023 capitulation form), which is why pre-print exposure is kept small and the magnitude, not the side, carries the conviction.

days.archetype: post-breakout Friday up-drift consolidation - new-high hold in an HDD-momentum regime, afternoon fade into the weekend gap
days.reasoning: Flows from 1106 ACTUAL 4.397: storage Thursday RALLIED +1350 THROUGH a bearish print (+33 inject, surprise +10.8 above, surplus widened to +141) to a new block high - the market telling us which force is in charge (the G6 load-bearing lesson: rising HDD heating-demand > storage surplus at the winter transition; fundamentals_role says the bearish print is a lean of last resort, dominated by the running trajectory). The 1106 reveal fingerprint is decisive against fading: continuation-asymmetry is UP-dominant (big up-legs 8/12 healthy vs down big 3/8, down-legs dying 5/29) with NO old-swing continuation-collapse (contrast 1008's 0/15) and mild turn_exhaustion (-0.277) - the up-swing is STILL HEALTHY at the extreme. swing_exhaustion_reversion is armed (cum-extreme +800, at_block_extreme high, 5-of-6 up sessions) but only HALF-lit: the counter-move evidence is a single last-hour -160 tick, which rhymes with the 1007 roll-over but WITHOUT 1007's continuation-collapse confirmation - the brain says do NOT blind-fade a still-trending block on half a trigger, and G6 proved the reversion is a give-back the block V's straight back from (1105 -520 was exactly that one-day give-back, already exhausted). Day-into-day precedent: 1031, the Friday after the 1030 +2580 storage-Thursday breakout in this same HDD regime, continued UP modestly (+540) rather than reversing. daytype.weekday_archetype: Fri = range, but the range cap is partially overridden by the high-momentum regime - I read that as an up-drift day, not a big trend day: non-catalyst per magnitude.catalyst_condition_sort, so magnitude sized DOWN vs Thu. Shape: soft overnight carry following the last-hour down tick, US-morning continuation attempt that makes marginal new highs, then afternoon profit-taking/positioning into the weekend info gap trims the close off the high (the real repricing verdict is Monday's weekend-gap mover). Lean UP, modest net; the give-back risk (1105 rhythm off a fresh high) is why the size stays small rather than the side flipping.
